# Changelog

https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/changelog

# Changelog

## [Introducing the Appier Enterprise Console (AEC)](/changelog/introducing-the-appier-enterprise-console-aec)

__ almost 2 years ago by Appier

We're excited to announce that starting this month, we're initiating a rollout of Appier's new, unified enterprise platform: the Appier Enterprise Console, or AEC for short. Aiming to provide a seamless and consistent user experience, AEC will serve as the centralized, cross-product management platform for Appier's full-funnel marketing solutions, including AIQUA, BotBonnie, AIRIS, and AIXON.

## [Single Sign-On](/changelog/single-sign-on)

 __ about 2 years ago by Appier

Starting from February 20, 2024, Single Sign-On (SSO) is applied to the following consoles, meaning that these consoles now share the same login credentials.

## [New email sender requirements from Gmail and Yahoo](/changelog/new-sender-requirements-from-gmail-and-yahoo)

 __ about 2 years ago by Appier

Starting in early 2024, Gmail and Yahoo will begin enforcing new measures for bulk senders. These new email sender requirements are aimed at enhancing security and reducing spam in your inbox:

## [Scheduled Maintenance, Tuesday Jun 28, 5:00 - 7:00 AM (UTC+8)](/changelog/scheduled-maintenance-tuesday-jun-28-500-700-am-utc8)

__ almost 4 years ago by Appier

On Tuesday, June 28th at 5:00 AM (UTC+8), AIQUA will have a scheduled maintenance for approximately two hours. During the maintenance period, several AIQUA features will be unavailable and campaign deliveries will be paused.

## [Enhancements to Campaign Reports](/changelog/improvements-to-report-data)

 __ almost 4 years ago by Appier

In order to enhance the quality and accuracy of campaign performance data, AIQUA has removed web bot traffic from Applebot, Googlebot, and AdsBot from campaign reports, effective May 31, 2022.

## [Scheduled Maintenance: Thursday March 24, 5:00-8:00 AM (UTC+8)](/changelog/scheduled-maintenance-thursday-march-22-500-800-am-utc8)

__ about 4 years ago by Appier

On Thursday, March 24 at 5:00 AM (UTC+8), AIQUA will have a scheduled downtime to release several new features, including single sign-on and two-factor authentication. The AIQUA Dashboard will be unavailable for approximately three hours.

## [Changes to app push metrics and delivery take effect on December 28, 2021](/changelog/changes-in-delivery-and-metrics-of-app-push)

 __ over 4 years ago by Appier

In order to make the number of reachable users for app push campaigns more clear and accurate, the following changes will be applied to AIQUA starting from **December 28, 2021**.

## [Recommendation 1.0 will be deprecated on December 31, 2021](/changelog/recommendation-10-deprecation-notice)

 __ over 4 years ago by Appier

After the deprecation date, all Appier SDK (Web, Android, iOS, and React Native) methods for Recommendation  
1.0 will return a non-**`HTTP 200 OK`** status code.

## [Scheduled Maintenance: Tuesday November 16, 5:00-7:00 AM (UTC+8)](/changelog/aiqua-scheduled-maintenance-tuesday-nov-16)

__ over 4 years ago by Appier

On November 16 at 5:00 AM (UTC+8), there will be scheduled downtime for approximately 2 hours. During the maintenance window, [AIQUA dashboard](https://aiqua.appier.com/) will not be accessible and campaign delivery will be paused.

## [Important Updates about Appier Mobile SDK](/changelog/important-updates-about-appier-mobile-sdk)

 __ almost 5 years ago by Appier

Recently, there are several important updates regarding Appier Mobile SDK that require you to take actions.

# Introducing The Appier Enterprise Console Aec

https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/changelog/introducing-the-appier-enterprise-console-aec

[Back to All](/changelog)

# Introducing the Appier Enterprise Console (AEC)

__ almost 2 years ago by Appier

We're excited to announce that starting this month, we're initiating a rollout of Appier's new, unified enterprise platform: the Appier Enterprise Console, or AEC for short. Aiming to provide a seamless and consistent user experience, AEC will serve as the centralized, cross-product management platform for Appier's full-funnel marketing solutions, including AIQUA, BotBonnie, AIRIS, and AIXON.

## 

A new, unified Appier console

You may have noticed that [Appier's omnichannel journey maps](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/getting-started-with-journey-maps) feature isn't in the same console as your AIQUA account's settings and other AIQUA features like campaign, segment, and recommendation features. After your account migration to AEC, all AIQUA and BotBonnie features will be accessible from a single, unified console.

![](https://files.readme.io/18fbfdb-aec-sidebar.png)

Currently, AIQUA and BotBonnie accounts are eligible for migration to the new enterprise console. In future milestones, AIRIS and AIXON accounts will also be accessible from AEC, and migration for these products will be announced at a later date.

## 

Unified settings and account management

We're introducing shared settings and setup, such as channel integrations and account management, meaning you won't have to log in to AIQUA and BotBonnie separately, and channel integrations will be available for both product's features.

![](https://files.readme.io/db75149-aec-channels.png)

## 

Rollout timeline

The rollout for AEC begins in May 2024 and will progress over the next few quarters. Your customer success manager will provide you with details and specific timelines as your transition date approaches. No action is needed from you—we'll handle the console migration for you.

# Recommendation 10 Deprecation Notice

https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/changelog/recommendation-10-deprecation-notice

[Back to All](/changelog)

# Recommendation 1.0 will be deprecated on December 31, 2021

 __ over 4 years ago by Appier

After the deprecation date, all Appier SDK (Web, Android, iOS, and React Native) methods for Recommendation  
1.0 will return a non-**`HTTP 200 OK`** status code.

Please migrate your website, mobile app, and campaign creative dynamic content to [Recommendation 2.0](doc:recommendations-v2), AIQUA's improved recommendation service that provides a fuller feature set than version 1.0.

* * *

## 

Recommendation 2.0 improvements

### 

Analytics dashboard for recommendation scenarios

  * View analytics & performance metrics for your Recommendation 2.0 scenarios on the AIQUA Dashboard under **Recommendation > Scenario List**.



### 

Additional filtering options

  * In addition to the filtering options supported in version 1.0, Recommendation 2.0 supports product ID blocklists and filtering by purchased product.



### 

More comprehensive recommendation model support

  * In addition to the recommendation models supported in version 1.0, Recommendation 2.0 supports new models such as **Similar Product Attributes** , **Similar Images** , and **Event Also Event**. See the [Recommendation 2.0 docs](doc:creating-scenario-recommendation-20#step-3-select-a-recommendation-model) for a full list of available models. _To enable the new recommendation models, please contact your customer success manager._



* * *

## 

In-App and on-site migration to Recommendation 2.0

Please remove all Recommendation 1.0 methods and re-integrate your website or app with Recommendation 2.0:

  * [Web SDK: Recommendation 2.0](doc:web-sdk-getting-recommendations-v2)
  * [Android SDK: Recommendation 2.0](doc:android-sdk-recommendation-20)
  * [iOS SDK: Recommendation 2.0](doc:ios-sdk-recommendation-20)
  * [React Native SDK: Recommendation 2.0](doc:react-native-sdk-recommendation-20)



## 

Dynamic Content migration to Recommendation 2.0

Please replace Recommendation 1.0 syntax in your campaign creative's dynamic content with the new Recommendation 2.0 syntax. For instructions on Recommendation 2.0 setup and syntax generation, see [Dynamic Content based on Recommendation 2.0](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#based-on-recommendation-20).

# Scheduled Maintenance Thursday March 22 500 800 Am Utc8

https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/changelog/scheduled-maintenance-thursday-march-22-500-800-am-utc8

[Back to All](/changelog)

# Scheduled Maintenance: Thursday March 24, 5:00-8:00 AM (UTC+8)

__ about 4 years ago by Appier

On Thursday, March 24 at 5:00 AM (UTC+8), AIQUA will have a scheduled downtime to release several new features, including single sign-on and two-factor authentication. The AIQUA Dashboard will be unavailable for approximately three hours.

## 

System Availability

  * **The AIQUA dashboard will not be accessible during the maintenance.**
  * There will be no impact on campaign delivery, the Recommendation service, or the AIQUA APIs.
  * There will be no impact on user attribute and event logging via Appier SDK. Data collection will be uninterrupted.



## 

New Features

The following identity and access management features will be available after the maintenance:

  * **Single Sign-On (SSO)** : SSO will be applied to AIQUA and AIXON, meaning that both products will share the same login credentials. If you're using the same login email address for both AIQUA and AIXON, you'll need to use your AIQUA password to log in to AIXON after the maintenance.

  * **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)** : Two-factor authentication is an extra step in the log-in process that requires users to verify their identity by providing an additional piece of information beyond their username and password. Available upon request; please contact your customer success manager for more information.

  * **24-Hour Automatic Logout** : In order to prevent deactivated users from accessing the AIQUA Dashboard, logged-in users without any activity for 24 hours will be automatically logged out.




* * *

We appreciate your patience and understanding. If you have any questions or issues, please contact your customer success manager or Appier Support ([[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#94f1e7e7cbe7e1e4e4fbe6e0d4f5e4e4fdf1e6baf7fbf9)).

# Single Sign On

https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/changelog/single-sign-on

[Back to All](/changelog)

# Single Sign-On

 __ about 2 years ago by Appier

Starting from February 20, 2024, Single Sign-On (SSO) is applied to the following consoles, meaning that these consoles now share the same login credentials.

  * AIQUA: <https://aiqua.appier.com/>
  * AIXON: <https://aixon.appier.com/>
  * Appier Enterprise Console: <https://console.appier.com/>
    * BotBonnie (Enterprise plan)
    * Journey Maps



> 👍
> 
> If you are accessing BotBonnie through `https://console.botbonnie.com`, this change does not affect you. SSO is currently only applied to the Appier Enterprise Console (`https://console.appier.com/`).

* * *

## 

Required actions

To avoid login issues, make sure you use the same user account to log into all consoles listed above.

If you have different login credentials for the consoles, please follow the instructions below.

  * **Same login email and password** : If you are using the same email and password for the consoles above, no action is needed.

  * **Same login email but different passwords** : If you are using the same email but different passwords to log in to the consoles, please use your AIQUA / AIXON password for all consoles listed above.

  * **Different login emails** : If you are using different emails to log in to the above consoles, grant Appier Enterprise Console access to your AIQUA / AIXON login account, and use your AIQUA / AIXON login account for all consoles above.

For example, if you are using `[[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)` for AIQUA / AIXON and `[[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)` for Appier Enterprise Console, you'll need to let `[[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)` access Appier Enterprise Console by sending an invite.

To send an invite, log in to [Appier Enterprise Console](https://console.appier.com) , go to **Chat-BotBonnie** > **Settings** > **Team member** and click **Invite**. If you do not have admin access to Appier Enterprise Console, ask a colleague with admin access to send the invite to you.

![](https://files.readme.io/dc95b89-Screen_Shot_2024-03-13_at_7.26.24_PM.png)



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Login email addresses are not case-sensitive, but it's recommended to use lower-case letters.

# Getting Started with AIQUA

Using AIQUA, you can engage your customers across various channels from a single platform. In a nutshell, AIQUA allows you to:

  * **[Collect user data](doc:user-data-collection)** including user behaviors on your websites and apps as well as your own set of user data (e.g. your CRM system).
  * **[Segment audience](doc:segments-create)** using the data collected as conditions.
  * Create customized **[campaigns](doc:campaigns-getting-started)** to target different audience segments.
  * Access [**Performance reports**](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-view-performance) to understand how your campaigns are performing.



* * *

## 

What can I know about my users?

Having user data is crucial in creating campaigns that are relevant to your users. By integrating with Appier Enterprise Service SDK ("Appier SDK"), you will be able to collect the following data about your online users.

  * User attributes from your websites and apps (e.g. email submitted through account registration)
  * User events from your websites and apps (e.g. a user added products to cart)



In addition, you may have your own set of data for your registered members (e.g. your CRM system) that you can upload to AIQUA.

  * Offline user attributes (e.g. user's birthday from your CRM system)
  * Offline user events (e.g. purchase data of a registered member in your physical stores)



By linking the above online and offline data, AIQUA helps you gain a holistic view of your users across platforms. See [User Data Collection](doc:user-data-collection) for more details.

* * *

## 

What can I do with AIQUA?

Once you have data about your users, you can segment audience and create personalized campaigns. Here's an example on how you can use AIQUA to reduce cart abandonment.

  * **Collect user data** : Some users logged in to your website and added products to their shopping cart. By having purchase data from your online and offline platforms on AIQUA, you can single out the users who did not proceed to checkout.

  * **Segment audience** : On the AIQUA dashboard, you can create an audience segment to include users who have added products to cart, and then exclude those who have purchased. You now have a segment of users who left products in the cart without checking out.


![](https://files.readme.io/0ee98e3-Screen_Shot_2021-01-08_at_10.23.02_AM.png)

  * **Create customized campaign** : Now you can create an email campaign to remind users about products forgotten in their carts and offer free shipping. By utilizing AIQUA's [Dynamic Content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) feature, you can include each user's name and information about the actual products in each user's cart.

![](https://files.readme.io/9c218cd-Screen_Shot_2021-01-08_at_1.10.58_AM.png)   


To be able to collect user data and create campaigns, you will need to complete the following integrations.

* * *

## 

1\. Integrate platforms with the Appier SDK

First, you need to integrate your website and app with the Appier Enterprise Service SDK ("Appier SDK"). This enables your website and app to show campaign notifications to users, and to collect basic user data such as cookies, device types, and site visits.

See instructions on how to integrate different platforms:

  * **Website:** See [Integrating with the Appier Web SDK](doc:integrating-with-the-aiqua-web-sdk).
  * **Android App:** See [Android SDK Overview](doc:android-sdk-overview).
  * **iOS App:** See [iOS SDK Overview](doc:ios-sdk-integration-overview).



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
>   * If your website is using multiple domains (e.g. [www.abc.com](http://www.abc.com), [www.abc2.com](http://www.abc2.com)) or subdomains (e.g. blog.abc.com, shop.abc.com), refer to [Cross-Domain Integration](doc:cross-domain-integration).
> 
>   * If your mobile app uses React Native framework, refer to: **React Native:** See [Installing the SDK via React Native](doc:installing-the-sdk-via-react-native).
> 
> 


* * *

## 

2\. Collect custom user data

The basic user data the Appier SDK can automatically collect by default is called **default user data**. In addition to default user data, you need to decide what other data you want to collect about your users and set your website and app to collect these **custom user data**.

  * [User data collection](doc:user-data-collection): Read the overview on how user data is tracked and used in AIQUA.
  * [Default user data](doc:default-aiqua-parameters): See the list of default events and attributes collected by the Appier SDK.
  * [Custom user data](doc:custom-user-data): See how to collect custom events and attributes.



* * *

## 

3\. Upload offline user data

If you have additional user data in your database (e.g. your CRM system), you can upload these data to AIQUA using these methods:

  * [Upload via dashboard as a CSV file](doc:segments-upload-user-attributes)
  * [Upload via API](ref:bulk-upload-offline-users)



* * *

## 

4\. Third-party integrations

Set up the marketing channels you'd like to use to send campaigns via email, SMS, LINE, or Kakao.

[ ![Email](https://files.readme.io/ab6dcf2217131f9965e515b696f5229bd5615d8c54e7c7670c342ad9c4c94509-Mail.png) Email ](/docs/campaigns-getting-started-email) [ ![SMS/MMS](https://files.readme.io/10188113e00cd907230e1b68bf23499b6943297c8f6c3714b589a936d253e7b6-SMS.png) SMS/MMS ](/docs/campaigns-getting-started-sms-mms) [ ![LINE](https://files.readme.io/aa8cd57fab5f7b421d8c3b928c3a507cd5fd9aaae3d9b8e739dae61b15a5d681-LINE.png) LINE ](/docs/campaigns-getting-started-line) [ ![Kakao](https://files.readme.io/b33abe057f05b53ec7eb5da1a9879758c5e46e9170ae2f7c027e5e3809400705-KaKao_Talk.png) Kakao Moment ](/docs/campaigns-getting-started-kakao-moment) [ ![Kakao](https://files.readme.io/b33abe057f05b53ec7eb5da1a9879758c5e46e9170ae2f7c027e5e3809400705-KaKao_Talk.png) Kakao (Chingu Talk) ](/docs/campaigns-getting-started-kakao-chingu-talk)

# Account Overview

Go to the bottom left corner of the AIQUA Dashboard and click on your account name to access the following pages containing account-wide settings and information:

  * [Account Settings](doc:user-settings): Account details (e.g. app ID, API key) and account-wide settings.
  * [Usage Information](doc:account-usage-information): Delivery statistics for each paid channel in AIQUA (email and SMS).

# Setting Web Push Prompts (Web Pixel Settings)

Adjust prompt timing and customize all web push subscription assets

Web push notifications can only be sent to desktop and Android users who have opted in to receive them from your website. For websites integrated with Appier SDK, the browser displays a system prompt to site visitors to obtain their permission.

The system prompt is the browser's native prompt, where the message and buttons cannot be modified.

  * If the user clicks **Allow** , then the user is subscribed to your push notifications.
  * If the user clicks **Block** , the browser will not show system prompts to this user again unless the user explicitly modifies the notification settings.
  * If the user takes no action on the system prompt by ignoring or closing it, the browser will show the system prompt again during the user's next visit. However, depending on the browser type, the browser may stop showing the system prompt if this happens too many times.

![\(https://files.readme.io/6c46944-Screen_Shot_2020-03-20_at_1.49.27_PM.png](https://files.readme.io/6c46944-Screen_Shot_2020-03-20_at_1.49.27_PM.png)

* * *

## 

Configure web pixel settings

Go to the AIQUA dashboard, click your account name in the lower-left corner and click **Web Pixel Settings**. You can also access this setting page during your final step on web Integration.

![](https://files.readme.io/6d648b398f947087145309c80d1cf390fefa45ada8a2170545541410c7311c6b-aq-ec-web-pixel-settings.png)

The following types of prompt are available:

  * **General settings** : Set the timing for displaying subscription prompts.
  * **Opt-in prompt** : AIQUA's custom prompt that precedes the system prompt.
  * **Opt-in tip** : AIQUA's custom opt-in tips to show users how to manually allow notifications.
  * **Change your mind prompt** : AIQUA's custom prompt that encourages declined users to unblock.
  * **Pop-up on subscription** : AIQUA's custom pop-up to welcome users who subscribed.

![https://files.readme.io/c3c7079-PromptOverview.png](https://files.readme.io/c3c7079-PromptOverview.png)

* * *

## 

General settings

These settings control the timing for when subscription prompts appear on your site.

Setting| Description| Notes on Behavior  
---|---|---  
**Time delay before the subscription prompt is shown**|  Specifies the delay (in seconds) before the first subscription prompt appears after a user visits your site.| If the **Opt-in Prompt** or **Change Your Mind Prompt (CYMP)** is enabled, this delay applies to those prompts instead of the system prompt. This setting does not apply to prompts triggered by [Subscription Boosts](doc:campaigns-in-web-creative-subscription-boost).  
**Delay between two subscription prompts**|  Specifies the time (in seconds) AIQUA waits before showing the same prompt again to a user who has previously seen it (_system prompt_ or **Opt-in Prompt**).| This delay does not apply to the **Change Your Mind Prompt (CYMP)**.  
  
> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> **Delay between two subscription prompts** cannot be set to `0`. AIQUA will apply 3600 seconds when 0 is entered in this field. Setting zero delay isn't recommended as frequent prompts may have a negative impact on user experience.

![](https://files.readme.io/e1b78a382b21884e0b0f444599780c196835f2944ca900eb5841c46c805575c5-general-settings.png)

* * *

## 

Opt-in Prompt

The **Opt-in Prompt** , also known as a soft prompt or pre-prompt, is a custom AIQUA message you can display before the browser's native system prompt. This configuration allows you to increase the subscription rate by offering incentives and customizing your message. If a user declines the customized **Opt-in Prompt** , you can show it again later during their next visit. This avoids the browser permanently blocking future prompts, which happens when a user blocks the system prompt.

### 

Configure the Opt-in Prompt

To enable, select the **Use Opt-In Prompt** check box. Customize the following fields:

Field| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Title / Message**|  Yes| Enter the custom text to encourage users to subscribe.  
**Icon Url**|  No| Change the default bell icon in the top-left corner if necessary.  
**Opt-in Button Text**|  Yes| Adjust the text of the opt-in button.  
**Opt-in Button Color**|  Yes| Adjust the color of the opt-in button.  
**Close Button Text**|  Yes| Adjust the text of the close button.  
**Prompt Message Location**|  Yes| Set the prompt position to **Left** or **Center**.  
**Include an overlay**|  Yes| Select **Yes** to gray out the area outside the prompt.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/891da1c533a3fb0ccf104ae0a8517fe3d068f889d2e56a6c3ca625b801bb4989-opt-in-prompt.png)

* * *

## 

Opt-in Tip

The **Opt-in Tip** is a message intended for Chrome users who are enrolled in the browser's [Quieter Permission UI](doc:whats-quieter-permission-ui) and no longer see the system prompt. It guides users on how to manually click the notification icon on the address bar to allow notifications.

  * If you have enabled [**Subscription boost**](doc:campaigns-in-web-creative-subscription-boost) in the In-web campaigns, the subscription boost notification also pops up with the **Opt-in Tip** when triggered.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Supported browser
> 
>   * Chrome
> 


### 

Configure the Opt-in Tip

To enable, select the **Use Opt-In Tip** check box. Customize the following fields:

Field| Description  
---|---  
**Title / Message**|  Enter the custom text to encourage users to subscribe.  
**Background Color**|  Adjust the color of the background.  
**Text Color**|  Adjust the color of the text.  
**Location**|  Adjust the location of the tip on the browser.  
**Include an overlay**|  Select **Yes** to gray out the area outside the prompt.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/4795e8395a463acd78759125b664ad91f56af0be23c1c67e263113b6dad0b992-opt-in-tip.png)

* * *

## 

Change Your Mind Prompt (CYMP)

Select the **Change Your Mind Prompt** checkbox to customize a message that tells users who have already clicked "Block" on the system prompt to manually change the notification settings in their browser in order to unblock notifications.

![](https://files.readme.io/81f7c3b0f7be3b5c63364345be307ade77f411cad474c8f29a647a4911557313-cymp.png)

To enable, select the **Use CYMP** check box. Customize the following fields:

Field| Description  
---|---  
**Message for Desktop Users**|  Enter the prompt message for desktop users.  
**Message for Android Mobile Users**|  Enter the prompt message for Android mobile users.  
**Background Color**|  Change the background color of the prompt.  
**Text Color**|  Change the text color of the prompt.  
**Duration to Prompt (days)**|  The number of days AIQUA waits after a user blocks the system prompt before showing the **CYMP** during that user's next site visit.  
  
* * *

## 

Pop-Up on subscription

Customize a pop-up subscription message in HTML editor, which is displayed immediately after a user successfully clicks "Allow" on the system prompt.

![](https://files.readme.io/3f6e040-Screen_Shot_2020-03-18_at_6.59.08_PM_copy.png)

### 

Configure the Pop-Up on Subscription

  1. **Use Pop-Up on Subscription** : Select the checkbox to enable it.
  2. **HTML pop-up** : Use the editor to create what you want the users to see after they have subscribed. For example, you can provide a coupon code in the message to the user who subscribed to the web push.
  3. **Include an overlay** : Select **Yes** to gray out the background.

![](https://files.readme.io/20e9b605a11cbf953c8e5f82362c08cc344d618755328f4846f162b07475e287-pop-un-subscription-html.png)

# Usage Information

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> This feature is only available if you're subscribed to AIQUA's email or SMS services. Contact your customer success manager for more information.

## 

Overview

Your account's usage information page details the total volume of messages your campaigns deliver, which can be used to estimate the potential delivery expenses incurred. For details on which usage metrics incur costs, see the usage definitions. Total and daily usage within a specified date range are visible for each supported channel.

Currently, usage information is supported for the following channels:

  * Email
  * SMS



To view your account's usage information, click on your account name in the lower left corner of the AIQUA Dashboard, then click **Usage Information**.

![](https://files.readme.io/77e5917-usage-information-navigation.png)

Select the channel and date range you want to view usage data for (date range limitations apply). You can also export the usage report to a CSV file.

![](https://files.readme.io/f71a88e-usage-information-type-and-date-range.png)

* * *

## 

Usage definitions

### 

Usage definition by channel

Refer to the following definitions of _usage_ to understand which metric is used to calculate costs for each channel. For detailed definitions of each metric, see Usage metrics.

  * Email usage is defined by the **Email Sent** metric.
  * SMS usage is defined by the **SMS Credits Used** metric.



### 

Usage metrics

Usage metric| Definition  
---|---  
**Email Sent**|  The total number of email sent by all campaigns associated with this account. Determines email channel costs.  
**Sent (Credits Charged)**|  The total number of SMS delivered by all campaigns associated with this account.  
**SMS Credits Used**|  The total number of SMS credits used by all campaigns associated with this account. Determines SMS channel costs.Note that **SMS Credits Used** may be greater than **Sent (Credits Charged)**. Actual SMS credit usage is based on message length, language, and character encoding scheme.  
  
## 

Exporting the usage report

Export a CSV file containing a report with your account's usage data by selecting the **Email** or **SMS** tab, then clicking the **Export Report** button.

![](https://files.readme.io/7665ea1-usage-information-report.png)

In the **Export Usage Report** modal that appears, complete the following:

  1. Specify a date range. Usage data is unavailable for dates before April 1, 2022.
  2. Enter up to 10 emails that you want the report download link to be sent to.
  3. Click **Export**. When the report is ready, an email containing the download link for the report will be sent to the email(s) you specified. It takes one to two days for the download link to be sent.

![](https://files.readme.io/14f611c-export-usage-report.png)

The email containing your usage report's download link also includes your business name, the channel type, and date range of the data.

![](https://files.readme.io/11b0dd7-usage-info-email-content.png)

* * *

## 

Date range notes and limitations

  * **Usage data is only available starting from April 1, 2022**.
  * Only data from the past 12 months can be viewed on the AIQUA Dashboard. This means that the start date cannot be more than 12 months before the current date. This limitation doesn't apply to usage report exports.
  * Usage data for each date is based on the time zone configured in your account settings.

# November 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Journey maps: AI-based send time optimization for push and email

[Send time optimization](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/message-node#send-time-optimization) is now supported for push and email campaigns in journey maps. This feature uses AI to determine the best delivery time for each user based on real-time user behavior patterns, improving engagement. It also respects the blackout window in your account settings.

![](https://files.readme.io/d429799742e858b9b2a35d208de10bc9e54fb01a06bdcbd8f544b70a25856069-message-node-sto.png)

### 

Recommendation: New exclusion filter

We’ve added three [exclusion filters](doc:creating-scenario-recommendation-20#exclusion-rules) to control which products are excluded from each recommendation scenario, focusing recommendations on items users haven't interacted with yet:

  * Recently purchased
  * Added to cart
  * Recently viewed

![](https://files.readme.io/e769212283052630ebf412e1fd83f9aae6f662f78e3842f6ad875aaac210e7c1-exclusion-filters.png)

# April 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Segment list: Updated daily refresh behavior for dynamic segment

Dynamic segments now refresh daily only if they’ve been active within the past seven days. Previously, segments were refreshed daily if they had been active within the last 30 days.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> If you need daily refresh enabled for segments that have been inactive for more than seven days, contact your customer success manager.

### 

Unified segments: Consistent creation flow across AIQUA and AIRIS

We've introduced a consistent interface for creating unified segments in both AIQUA and AIRIS. This update streamlines the segment creation workflow, reduces errors, and save time for marketers working across platforms.

In AIQUA, go to **Segments** > **Segment list** , click **\+ Create segment** , and select **[Conditions (Beta)](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/creating-a-segment)**.

![](https://files.readme.io/4224d39e5e56c6de8b90ab315a04795c21eba61458d3efad16ac7d90d0899d13-edit-2.gif)

### 

Email and SMS campaign: Set custom sending caps per campaign

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Custom sending cap is a closed beta feature. Contact your customer success manager to learn more.

You can now define a custom sending cap for each email or SMS (MMS, LMS) campaign to help control delivery volume and prevents accidental overspending.

![](https://files.readme.io/bb39e787e117dfddffa989198ba1f3cb054c788f5093c91c1bbb2bca017deebb-sending-cap-email.png)

# August 2024

## 

New features and updates

### 

Onsite Experience: Enhanced campaign management

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Contact your customer success manager to learn more about Onsite Experience.

We’ve introduced new enhancements that allow you to search, filter, sort, and archive Onsite Experience campaigns. These updates are designed to simplify the process of locating and managing your campaigns, streamlining your workflow.

![](https://files.readme.io/35417d3983fd6391e69c8d4f8cc8ceb4bf9c1a8f1aefd717208ab5569fb467e5-manage_onsite_experience.png)

### 

Email Drag & Drop Editor: Preheader support

Increase your email open rates with our new preheader support feature. Email preheaders appear next to the subject line and provide a brief preview of your email content, grabbing your audience’s attention right from the inbox. Please note that preheader support is only available when using [Drag & Drop Editor](doc:creatives-email-drag-and-drop-editor). In addition, preheaders:

  * Can contain dynamic content and emojis, allowing you to customize your pre-headers for maximum impact.
  * Are compatible with the “Test Your Creative” feature, making it easier than ever to optimize your email campaigns.

![](https://files.readme.io/586d00815156fda94797dd9381d7e22d952ddf319569e341a12b387f0501b9bb-email-preheader.png)

### 

Journey maps: Searching for users by LINE UID during journey testing

We've expanded the user search capabilities during journey testing, allowing you to search for users by LINE UID, in addition to the existing searchable attributes (email, phone number, and user ID).

# December 2024

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Email Editor: Improved error detection for dynamic content

We've improved error detection for dynamic content on the Drag & Drop Editor and HTML Editor. Clear error messages help you identify and fix issues during email campaign creation.

![](https://files.readme.io/b8e1608c5daa20df81ff8ac810fcfbeca4e4b4c6b954485ab8304b4f652c55a6-email-editor.png)

### 

Journey maps: Additional templates

We've introduced 10 new prebuilt templates to journey maps to help you accelerate campaign creation on common marketing scenarios:

  * Churn user engagement
  * Update user attribute
  * Sync LINE profiles with web profiles (Webchat)
  * Browse abandonment (short cycle)
  * Audience sync (retargeting)
  * Audience sync (first purchase incentive)
  * Audience sync (retargeting suppression)
  * Member birthday reminder
  * Drive offline user to online purchase
  * Product launch (long cycle)

![](https://files.readme.io/aecf2832da5f10ea59491c41b47990ebf19ce5197335f0628519fccdf1226429-journey-map-new-templates.png)

### 

Creative Studio: Faster performance

We've improved Creative Studio templates loading performance by 95% for smoother user experience.

# February 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Campaign AI Copilot: Enhanced AI-driven campaign creation

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Contact your customer success manager to learn more about AI Copilot.

We've upgraded AI Copilot with a more intuitive workflow, making it easier to create campaigns while ensuring AI-assisted content generation adapts to your brand’s style and tone:

  * Generate AI-assisted content that adapts to your brand’s voice.
  * Refine and customize AI-generated content with prompt suggestions.
  * Automatically generates content in the selected input language.

![](https://files.readme.io/2e7ac03c0566ffc68bba5d0a7a04b10bf5b8d8c42659d2b2a9b4595523f7aa4d-campaign-copilot2.png)

### 

Creative Studio: Enhanced template browsing and management

We've enhanced template management in Creative Studio, allowing you to find, organize, and customize templates more efficiently:

  * Filtering default template by **Goal** , **Format** , or **Device**.
  * Search for templates by name or ID.
  * Sort templates by **Last edited** or **Template name**.
  * Improve browsing performance with enhanced pagination.

![](https://files.readme.io/ee640759a7045d11ff079db95dcf839c74dd88122bad77986546c00dea890d36-default-template-filter.png)

### 

Recommendation: New user-based models

We've introduced three user-based models to recommend up to 20 of the most recent products based on user behaviors, improving personalized shopping experiences:

  * **Recently viewed**
  * **Recently purchased**
  * **Recently added to cart**



For more details, see [Recommendation model reference](doc:recommendation-models#recommendation-model-reference).

### 

Journey maps: Prevent duplicate messages

To prevent users from receiving duplicate messages in a journey campaign, journey maps now ensure each LINE UID receives only one message per campaign node per run.

### 

Journey maps: Webhook processing with batching support

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Contact your customer success manager to learn more about webhook node.

We've introduced batching support for the webhook node, allowing you to enable batch requests, set a batch size, and define a minimum interval window for more efficient data processing. For more details, see [webhook node](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/journey-maps-advanced-node).

![](https://files.readme.io/2c717f17aa9b29421ce57e76aa09e3bde92aafbfd2c57fc837fe18c25821f783-jm-webhook.png)

# July 2024

## 

New features and updates

### 

Recommendation: Online-merge-offline (OMO) support

AIQUA recommendations now support OMO mode, enriching model training data with both online and offline events to provide even more precise product recommendations!

Previously, standard recommendation models were based only on online events, i.e. events logged via Appier SDK. Now, you can upload offline events, e.g. a user's purchase history at a physical location and activate OMO mode in your account settings to use both online and offline events for recommendation model training. Contact your customer success manager to enable OMO mode in your account.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note: Models supporting OMO mode
> 
>   * All standard models support OMO mode, except for **Recommended for You (Advanced)**.
>   * Professional Service custom models can support all modes (online, offline, and OMO).
> 


### 

Analytics Studio: Offline conversion support in the campaign performance data source

The **Campaign performance** data source now contains the **Offline Conversions** and **Offline Conversion Value** metrics.

![](https://files.readme.io/827130e-analytics-studio-offline-conversion-metrics.png)

### 

Regular campaigns: Merged push campaigns

In addition to a brand-new look and feel, we've completely overhauled the creation flow for regular campaigns, allowing you to create a single push campaign that supports multiple channels, including Android, iOS, and Web. The new, streamlined process allows you to configure creative types and campaign messages for each channel from a single screen.

Performance data for regular push campaigns is available for aggregated metrics (all channels) and channel-specific metrics on the performance page on the AIQUA dashboard as well as downloadable CSV reports.

![](https://files.readme.io/dc00445-push-campaign-channels.png)   


> 👍
> 
> ### 
> 
> Tip
> 
> See [Push (Web and App)](doc:campaigns-regular-create-push) to learn how to create regular push campaigns using the new user interface.

### 

Web SDK optimizations

To improve Appier's cross-product synergy and optimize the Web SDK, we've revamped the project structure of the source code, allowing us to reduce the SDK file size from 501.5 KB to 399.8 KB. No behavior changes were introduced, so you don't need to make any changes to your integration.

### 

New custom fonts for the email drag & drop editor

We've added the following custom fonts for multiple languages, now available in the [email drag & drop editor](doc:creatives-email-drag-and-drop-editor):

  * 微軟正黑 (Mandarin)
  * Georgia (English)
  * Verdana (English)
  * Tahoma (Thai)
  * Arial (Vietnamese)
  * Noto Sans Japanese (Japanese)
  * Noto Serif Japanese (Japanese)

# July 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Recommendation: Preview recommendation results

You can now preview recommendation results immediately after training completes. The preview results show you:

  * The exact products or content your model will recommend.
  * The underlying logic, including reference events, source products, and filtering conditions.
  * How results change in real time when you adjust product filters or rules.

![](https://files.readme.io/cea345c5895eec4c25008d91c2a93ca3f59eef9d2824c5220576df99c1bd90ce-preview-recommendation-results.png)

### 

Recommendation: Category hot items model

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Contact your customer success manager to learn more about the **Category hot items** model.

We're introducing the new **Category hot items** model, which provides product category-specific recommendations. This model enhances the user experience by delivering more relevant popular recommendations based on a user's behavior, especially on category or listing pages.

### 

Analytics dashboard: Daily reachable users

The analytics dashboard now includes with a **Reachable users** chart that displays daily changes in new subscribers and unsubscribers for each channel. For more information, see [Dashboard](doc:analytics-pages-analytics-dashboard#reachable-users).

![](https://files.readme.io/88bb09f724c24a40bc524acd9564bae4f1275907005df50898768111d4d47de7-reachable-users.png)

### 

Regular email campaigns: Improved engagement with AI-based send time optimization

[Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-regular-create#send-time-optimization) is now available in regular email campaigns, using AI to determine the most optimal send time for each user in the 24-hour period following the campaign's scheduled send time. This improves engagement by increasing delivery effectiveness and reducing bias.

![](https://files.readme.io/2fd1278268cbd26186d7786875a76227ffee01dc29ec4f9573939aa27395c8ed-sto-email.png)

### 

Journey maps: Enhanced experiments node

We’ve enhanced the [experiment node](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/split-node#experiment) in journey maps to include control group testing, allowing you to measure the true uplift in conversion rates and incremental revenue.

![](https://files.readme.io/ead8e8aef22974e91058b84fa3d0e3412d26dedc61daaf902907739432790173-create-experiment-node.gif)

### 

Journey maps: LINE follow event tracking

The `follow` event for the [LINE](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/getting-started-with-journey-maps#line-integration) can now be selected as a **Goal conversion** event to track follower growth, or as an **Exit rule** to exclude users from a journey once they have followed the channel.

# June 2024

## 

New features and updates

### 

Campaign list loading enhancements

We've enhanced the campaign list loading experience by introducing segmented loading and a skeleton screen for campaign metrics. The campaign information and actions will be loaded and displayed as soon as they're ready, without needing to wait for metrics to finish loading.

![](https://files.readme.io/db306ef-campaign-loading-screen.png)

### 

Recommendation: Editable scenarios and scenario list redesign

Previously, the recommendation model used by a scenario couldn't be edited after the scenario was enabled. Now, you can [edit the recommendation model settings](doc:creating-scenario-recommendation-20#editing-scenario-settings) at any time, giving you the flexibility to seamlessly adjust the scenario to suit your marketing goals.

During the training period for the new settings, the scenario will continue using the previous settings to ensure uninterrupted service. While the update is in progress, the scenario status will be set to **Updating**.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> For scenarios using the **Autopilot** or **Professional Service - Custom Model** recommendation model, the model setting can't be edited.

![](https://files.readme.io/9c0dbad-scenario-edit.png)

In addition, we've improved the look and feel of the scenario list page and made some changes to make it easier to find the information you're looking for.

  * Filtering and sorting: You can now filter and sort scenarios by status, placement, and model type, making it easier to find exactly what you need.
  * Improved date picker: We've updated the date picker for a smoother experience, and the default date range is now set to **This Month** for your convenience.

![](https://files.readme.io/b59d0c0-scenario-list-revamp.png)

### 

Regular campaigns: Push campaign experiments with winning variants

The winning variant feature allows you to optimize push notifications by testing different variants of messages and automatically selecting the best performer. You can choose the traffic allocation, winning metric, and test duration, and the winning variant will be automatically selected.

This feature ensures the most effective push notification reaches your audience, enhancing campaign success and user engagement.

> 👍
> 
> To learn more about push campaign experiments with winning variants, see [Experiments: Push](doc:campaigns-experiments-regular-push).

![](https://files.readme.io/f9d5cbf-push-campaign-winner-distribution.png)

### 

Regular campaigns: Support for view-through attribution

View-through attribution (VTA) attributes conversions to campaign impressions even when a user:

  * Doesn't click on the notification.
  * Views other notifications during the attribution window.



When a user views the notification and completes the goal event within the attribution window, the goal event will be counted as a conversion.

![](https://files.readme.io/a6ab48b-view-through-attribution.png)

Please note that goal events in the view-through attribution window will be attributed across all campaigns. For example:

  1. A user views "Campaign A".
  2. The same user views "Campaign B".
  3. The user completes a goal event (converts) within the attribution window.



As a result, the conversion will be attributed to both "Campaign A" and "Campaign B".

### 

Segment trend: Handling missing data

If any segment daily refresh data is missing in the selected date range, linear interpolation will be used to plot a line between the known data points to ensure a clear trend chart and smooth lines. If you hover over the date with missing data, no dialog is displayed.

![](https://files.readme.io/2d0c5cf-segment-trend-chart.png)

* * *

## 

Fixes and changes

### 

New API rate limits

New API rate limits have been implemented for some AIQUA API endpoints. For details, please refer to the API documentation:

  * [Create an Offline User Upload Job](ref:create-an-offline-user-upload-job#rate-limits)
  * [Upload Offline Event Data (v2)](ref:upload-offline-event-data-v2#rate-limits)

# June 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Recommendation: Enhanced models with LLM for smarter results

We've upgraded several recommendation models using large language models (LLMs). These models now process and analyze your product content, including names, descriptions, and attributes, more effectively, going beyond basic keyword and attribute matching to deliver smarter and more relevant recommendations to your users.

In performance tests, campaigns using these LLM-powered models achieved an average 30% improvement in click-through rates (CTR).

The following models have been enhanced, and existing scenarios will automatically use the enhanced model:

  * Similar product attribute
  * Similar to your recently browsed products
  * Similar products you may like



### 

Analytics dashboard: Consolidated campaign performance

The new AIQUA analytics dashboard provides a consolidated, visual summary of campaign performance and user engagement across all channels. Quickly view key metrics, including:

  * Total active and reachable users
  * Total conversion value
  * Campaign activity and performance by campaign type



For more information, see [Dashboard](doc:analytics-pages-analytics-dashboard).

![](https://files.readme.io/3cf150944ae6691fd6dd5fbd247a2c886c2215ae95a50ceecb8d11ae5bc7af33-analytics-dashboard-overview.gif)

### 

Regular push campaign: Improved engagement with AI-based send time optimization

[Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-regular-create#send-time-optimization) for regular push campaigns now uses AI to determine the most optimal send time for each user in the 24-hour period following the campaign's scheduled send time. This improves engagement by increasing delivery effectiveness and reducing bias.

![](https://files.readme.io/87ec3b6-one-time-schedule.png)

* * *

## 

Fixes and changes

### 

Recommendation: Updated API endpoint

The [Get Recommendations](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/reference/get-recommendations-1) endpoint URL has been updated. If you're using the Recommendation API, please update the endpoint URL before July 31, 2025 to avoid service disruption.

# May 2024

## 

New features and updates

### 

Email campaigns now support one-click unsubscribe

All email campaigns now include a one-click unsubscribe button (via email list-unsubscribe header) at the top of the email. By default, AIQUA's default unsubscribe URL is used for the unsubscribe button, but if you'd like to process email unsubscriptions in your system, go to your account settings to [configure a custom email unsubscribe URL](doc:user-settings#email-list-unsubscribe-header).

![Unsubscription link at the top of the email \(list-unsubscribe header\)](https://files.readme.io/350bd1e-one-click-unsubscribe.png)

Unsubscribe link at the top of the email (list-unsubscribe header)

![Custom unsubscribe URL configuration in account settings](https://files.readme.io/d4bed21-email-list-unsubscribe-header-default-url.png)

Unsubscribe URL configuration in account settings

### 

New custom Korean fonts for the email drag & drop editor

We've added three new custom Korean fonts, available in the [email drag & drop editor](doc:creatives-email-drag-and-drop-editor):

  * Gowun Dodum (고운돋움)
  * Jua (배달의민족 주아체)
  * Do Huron (배달의민족 도현체)



### 

Set up to five offline conversion events

Previously, the `product_purchased` event was the only supported offline conversion event. Now, you can select up to [five offline conversion events](doc:user-settings#offline-conversion-and-attribution) in the account settings page, allowing for more precise and comprehensive performance metrics for regular and trigger campaigns.

![](https://files.readme.io/6804fdf-Screen_Shot_2024-03-20_at_3.20.54_PM.png)

### 

Send SMS campaigns via API

The [Send Campaign Notifications API](ref:send-campaign-notifications) now supports sending SMS campaigns. You can send SMS campaigns via API by specifying the campaign recipients' phone numbers or selecting an existing segment.

* * *

## 

Fixes and changes

### 

Bulk Upload Offline Users API: UTF-8 encoding error response

The [Create an Offline User Upload Job](ref:create-an-offline-user-upload-job) (Bulk Upload Offline Users API) now returns a **`400 Bad Request`** with the following error message if the uploaded file is not UTF-8 encoded: `“Data file without UTF-8 encoded is invalid”`.

### 

Fixes to iOS uninstall analytics

Faulty logic for calculating iOS uninstall counts has been fixed. As a result, you may observe an increase in iOS app uninstall counts. For details on how the number of app uninstalls is calculated, see [Uninstall Analytics](doc:using-uninstall-analytics).

# May 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Regular campaigns: Email and SMS campaign creation

We've introduced a new email and SMS regular campaign creation interface to streamline your setup process. The new interface guides you through four intuitive steps for efficient campaign creation. These steps include:

  1. **Audience** : Define your target audience and see an instant estimate of your audience size.
  2. **Creative** : Craft your personalized and engaging marketing content, including text, images, and links. You can also configure experiments to test different content variants.
  3. **Settings** : Set your campaign's sending schedule and configure additional conversion events, and manage campaign-specific frequency cap.
  4. **Review & launch**: Review your campaign before you send it.

![](https://files.readme.io/72f552107f02650c4a0e7c8940878352491f21423957b7ed985eb2225bb122b2-revamped-creation.gif)

# November 2024

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Regular campaign: Campaign list enhancements

We’ve introduced new enhancements on the regular campaign list to improve usability and optimize campaign management. The key improvements include:

  * New tag display: Tags are visible under the campaign name for easier identification.
  * Campaign statuses: Campaign statuses are directly displayed in the campaign list, enabling you to quickly filter and locate campaigns. To learn more, see [Searching and filtering campaigns](doc:campaigns-regular-manage#search-and-filter-campaigns).
  * Campaign list details: **Include segments** , **Exclude segments** , and **Next scheduled time** are now displayed in the campaign list. To learn more, see [Campaign list metrics](doc:campaigns-regular-managing#campaign-list-metrics).

![](https://files.readme.io/0ac359ffad3e627bd06c8b6b71a12273ebb6375e1598a35a07106f1a25a03230-regular-campaign-list.png)

### 

Journey maps: Offline conversion tagging and metrics

Journey maps have been updated to improve offline data management, enabling you to distinguish between online data collected via SDK and offline data uploaded through the API. The key enhancements include:

  * Offline tags: Automatically identify [offline events](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/getting-started-with-journey-maps#offline-events-and-segments) with an **Offline** tag, simplifying the process of tracking and setting conversion goals in your customer journeys.
  * Separate offline metrics: Gain comprehensive visibility into offline performance by tracking conversion counts and revenue independently. View online and offline conversion separately in the [Journey map list](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/journey-performance-and-analytics#journey-map-list) and detailed performance in the [Journey analytics](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/journey-performance-and-analytics#journey-analytics) tab.

![](https://files.readme.io/ae5648a0a723b4dfc7b1fd131a34118f9dee523ae9a5e8a219304e62907d1b86-journey-analytics-offline-conversion.png)

# November 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Journey maps: AI-based send time optimization for push and email

[Send time optimization](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/message-node#send-time-optimization) is now supported for push and email campaigns in journey maps. This feature uses AI to determine the best delivery time for each user based on real-time user behavior patterns, improving engagement. It also respects the blackout window in your account settings.

![](https://files.readme.io/d429799742e858b9b2a35d208de10bc9e54fb01a06bdcbd8f544b70a25856069-message-node-sto.png)

### 

Recommendation: New exclusion filter

We’ve added three [exclusion filters](doc:creating-scenario-recommendation-20#exclusion-rules) to control which products are excluded from each recommendation scenario, focusing recommendations on items users haven't interacted with yet:

  * Recently purchased
  * Added to cart
  * Recently viewed

![](https://files.readme.io/e769212283052630ebf412e1fd83f9aae6f662f78e3842f6ad875aaac210e7c1-exclusion-filters.png)

# October 2024

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Kakao Moment campaigns: New creative templates added

We’ve expanded our support for [Kakao Moment with three additional creative templates](doc:kakao-moment-campaigns#kakao-moment-creative-specifications) enhancing the flexibility and design options for your campaigns to better reach your audience:

  * Wide list
  * Carousel commerce
  * Carousel feed

![](https://files.readme.io/89c210aa2e44811d601aa373e41befef06bbf82c316c98939077a7ae7dcbb353-kakao-moment-new-templates.png)

### 

Recommendation: Performance date range extended

You can now view Recommendation performance metrics for up to 180 days, enabling better analysis of long-term trends and campaign effectiveness.

![](https://files.readme.io/76d6b1df9af51c081999ae76b822bec9e1ece898ba3852c6cd6818136f614db6-recommendation-180-days.png)

### 

New custom fonts for the email drag & drop editor

We've added two new custom English fonts, available in the [email drag & drop editor](doc:creatives-email-html-editor):

  * Inter
  * Poppins



* * *

## 

Fixes and changes

### 

Improved Delete Users API performance

User profiles deleted using the Delete Users API are now removed from segmentation immediately after the API call.

# October 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Journey maps: Support for up to 10 events in real-time event nodes

You can now specify up to 10 entry trigger events within a single **[real-time event node](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/entry-trigger-node#real-time-event)** and view traffic volume for each event. Previously, real-time event nodes supported only one entry trigger event.

![](https://files.readme.io/41ff3aeb3240c605dcd1108b281470bdd231c1105c22b8198ad60a5e3e01480f-multiple-event.png)

### 

Journey maps: Short URLs for SMS and LMS

You can add short URLs as dynamic content in journey maps, using either [AIQUA short URLs](doc:creatives-sms-mms#track-clicks-with-an-aiqua-short-url) or custom domain short URLs to send both SMS and LMS messages.

![](https://files.readme.io/3896b415618b022db2926b33558bf11ed8b8694695e3684492f17f304bb67837-jm-short-url.png)

### 

Recommendation: Revamped scenario creation

We've introduced a new recommendation scenario creation interface to make setup more intuitive. The new interface guides you through three steps: selecting a placement, choosing a recommendation model, and configuring business rules.

![](https://files.readme.io/fecc16fbc9d7a7091cbc40242a630e1f626a287513b2f54c46dfb7ea4a47f6d8-new-recommendation-scenario.png)

### 

Reports: Password-protected export files

To protect user data, exported reports now require a password. You’ll receive the exported report by email as usual, and you’ll be prompted to enter the password when opening the file. This applies to:

  * [User report](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-export-campaign-user-reports)
  * [Form report](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-download-form-data-in-web-in-app)
  * [Segment report](doc:segments-export-segment-reports)



Contact your customer success manager to enable password protection for your reports.

# September 2024

## 

New features and updates

### 

In-app campaigns (Creative Studio): Background overlay settings

You can now choose whether to display a background overlay in your in-app campaigns designed with Creative Studio. Disabling the background overlay allows users to interact with the app in areas not covered by the creative, providing a more flexible user experience.

![](https://files.readme.io/c754a650e24f222f747e517cffa01df09be6308fa875492ef126bf1f8d3de5a2-Frame_2.png)

### 

Kakao Moment campaign integration

We've introduced Kakao Moment campaigns in AIQUA, allowing you to leverage diverse and flexible creative templates, personalized dynamic content, and comprehensive data tracking for advanced targeting and detailed performance analytics.

For a complete overview and more details on setting up Kakao Moment campaigns, see [Kakao Moment campaigns](doc:campaigns-getting-started-kakao-moment).

![](https://files.readme.io/4209929119b96e61b6ac317d7e3febbc52489e97971ca81f94f785d027cf144f-0-kakao-moment-create.png)

### 

Onsite Experience: New single image template

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Contact your customer success manager to learn more about Onsite Experience.

We've added a new template for Onsite Experience campaigns that allows you to display a single image banner that redirects users to a specified URL when clicked. This offers a streamlined design for driving engagement through visual content.

![](https://files.readme.io/6e191bc74d943ef0e54be8b55d98f06b9575e6903789867cee1207219ca6c955-Onsite_experience__single_image.png)

# September 2025

## 

New features and enhancements

### 

Journey maps: Refine targeting for trigger events

You can now use the `is not` operator in **[Real-time event](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/entry-trigger-node#real-time-event)** and **[Wait for condition](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/wait-node#wait-for-condition)** nodes to filter out unwanted event properties in trigger event conditions for greater precision in audience targeting.

For example, you can filter out any user who purchases an item from the "Trials" product category from this journey.

![](https://files.readme.io/69243f0abb3db4cb49ac64386aec5972423d44b8be0b7bc49a17bff7eb38d707-jm_is_not.png)

### 

Journey maps: Exclude segments directly in Real-time event nodes

The **[Real-time event](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/entry-trigger-node#real-time-event)** node now supports excluding segments directly, eliminating the need to create extra single-use segments for each campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/479c9640a2df170c63cacad98f80658fb2a1852a7be4ba76b107cab6dd744318-jm_exclude_segment.png)

### 

Journey maps: Preview journeys from the journey list

You can now preview journey maps directly from the listing page, allowing you to quickly review setup details without opening the full editor.

![](https://files.readme.io/a5d9cf50a4c3d9c7f3d108621455f695d2b483725d8949fec8f9d06eb1251e5d-JM-listing_page.gif)

# Airbridge Integration Guide

## 

Overview

Integrating Airbridge with AIQUA offers significant benefits for enhancing marketing strategies and outcomes. Airbridge provides robust measurement, analytics, and fraud protection, ensuring accurate attribution and performance metrics across multiple channels and devices. By combining these capabilities with AIQUA's omnichannel marketing automation features, you can create targeted campaigns, optimize customer journeys, and increase conversions.

Before proceeding with the Airbridge integration, ensure you've completed the integration prerequisites. Once the prerequisites have been completed, follow these steps to complete the Airbridge integration with your app.

  1. Initialize the Airbridge SDK and track data
  2. Set up an ad channel integration in the Airbridge console
  3. Configure Appier postback settings
  4. Verify that events are collected properly



### 

Prerequisites

Complete the following steps before continuing with this guide:

  * Integrate your app with the Appier iOS or Android SDK. For detailed instructions, refer to the following guides:
    * [iOS SDK Overview](doc:ios-sdk-integration-overview)
    * [Android SDK Overview](doc:android-sdk-overview)
  * Integrate your app with the Airbridge SDK. For detailed instructions, refer to [Airbridge's documentation](https://help.airbridge.io/en/developers/getting-started).
  * Provide your app’s ID to your customer success manager. The app ID can be found in the app's URL. Refer to the instructions below for Android and iOS.



#### 

Retrieving your Android app ID

Retrieve the Android app ID from the `id` query parameter.

Example app URL| Example app ID  
---|---  
`https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox&hl=en`| `com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox`  
  
#### 

Retrieving your iOS app ID.

Retrieve the iOS app ID from the final portion of the URL, only including the portion after `id`.

Example app URL| Example app ID  
---|---  
`https://apps.apple.com/us/app/google/id284815942`| `284815942`  
  
* * *

## 

1\. Initialize the Airbridge SDK and track data

Follow the steps corresponding to the platform your app is for:

  * iOS
  * Android



### 

iOS

  1. Initialize the Airbridge SDK with automatic event collection disabled (`setAutoStartTrackingEnabled(false)`).



SwiftObjective-C
    
    
    AirBridge.setAutoStartTrackingEnabled(false)
    AirBridge.getInstance("<YOUR_AIRBRIDGE_APP_SDK_TOKEN>", appName: "<YOUR_AIRBRIDGE_APP_NAME>", withLaunchOptions:launchOptions)
    
    
    AirBridge.autoStartTrackingEnabled = NO;
    [AirBridge getInstance:@"<YOUR_AIRBRIDGE_APP_SDK_TOKEN>" appName:@"<YOUR_AIRBRIDGE_APP_NAME>" withLaunchOptions:launchOptions];

  2. Before tracking data:
     1. Initialize the Appier SDK.
     2. Use the Airbridge SDK to add the `"appier_app_id"` and `"appier_user_id"` user aliases.



SwiftObjective-C
    
    
    QGSdk.getSharedInstance().onStart("<YOUR_APPIER_APP_ID>", setDevProfile: false)
    let appierAppId = "<YOUR_APPIER_APP_ID>"
    let appierUserId = QGSdk.getSharedInstance().getAppierId()
    
    AirBridge.state()?.addUserAlias(withKey: "appier_app_id", value: appierAppId)
    AirBridge.state()?.addUserAlias(withKey: "appier_user_id", value: appierUserId)
    
    
    QGSdk *qgsdk = [QGSdk getSharedInstance];
    [qgsdk onStart:@"<YOUR_APPIER_APP_ID>" setDevProfile:NO];
    NSString *appierAppId = @"<YOUR_APPIER_APP_ID>";
    NSString *appierUserId = [qgsdk getAppierId];
    
    [AirBridge.state addUserAliasWithKey:@"appier_app_id" value: appierAppId];
    [AirBridge.state addUserAliasWithKey:@"appier_user_id" value: appierUserId];

  3. Start tracking data with the Airbridge SDK.



SwiftObjective-C
    
    
    AirBridge.startTracking()
    
    
    [AirBridge startTracking];

### 

Android

  1. Initialize the Airbridge SDK with automatic event collection disabled (`setAutoStartTrackingEnabled(false)`).



JavaKotlin
    
    
    AirbridgeConfig config = new AirbridgeConfig.Builder("<YOUR_AIRBRIDGE_APP_NAME>", "<YOUR_AIRBRIDGE_APP_SDK_TOKEN>")
        .setAutoStartTrackingEnabled(false)
        .build();
    Airbridge.init(application, config);
    
    
    val config = AirbridgeConfig.Builder("<YOUR_AIRBRIDGE_APP_NAME>", "<YOUR_AIRBRIDGE_APP_SDK_TOKEN>")
        .setAutoStartTrackingEnabled(false)
        .build()
    Airbridge.init(application, config)

  2. Before tracking data:
     1. Initialize the Appier SDK.
     2. Use the Airbridge SDK to add the `"appier_app_id"` and `"appier_user_id"` user aliases.



JavaKotlin
    
    
    QG.initializeSdk(application, "<YOUR_APPIER_APP_ID>");
    String appierAppId = "<YOUR_APPIER_APP_ID>";
    String appierUserId = QG.getInstance(context).getAppierId();
    
    Airbridge.getCurrentUser().setAlias("appier_app_id", appierAppId);
    Airbridge.getCurrentUser().setAlias("appier_user_id", appierUserId);
    
    
    QG.initializeSdk(application, "<YOUR_APPIER_APP_ID>")
    val appierAppId = "<YOUR_APPIER_APP_ID>"
    val appierUserId = QG.getInstance(context).appierId
    
    Airbridge.getCurrentUser().setAlias("appier_app_id", appierAppId)
    Airbridge.getCurrentUser().setAlias("appier_user_id", appierUserId)

  3. Start tracking data with the Airbridge SDK.



JavaKotlin
    
    
    Airbridge.startTracking();
    
    
    Airbridge.startTracking()

## 

2\. Set up an ad channel integration in the Airbridge console

  1. Log in to the Airbridge console. Go to **Integrations > Ad Channel Integration**, then select the **Appier** integration.

![](https://files.readme.io/a84143e-airbridge-1.png)

  2. Go to the **Postback** tab, and under the **Event schema** section, click **Configuration**.

![](https://files.readme.io/6cd169f-airbridge-2.png)

  3. Select all the events you want Airbridge to send to Appier, then click **Next**.

![](https://files.readme.io/612b736-airbridge-3.png)

  4. Next, customize event delivery rules based on your specific requirements, then click **Save**. For the best marketing automation results, we recommend sending all events (including unattributed) to Appier.

![](https://files.readme.io/6ef920f-airbridge-4.png)

  5. In the **Ad Channel Integration** page, confirm that the **Attributed to** column says **All channels** , meaning that your settings are configured properly, and Appier should successfully receive all postback events.

![](https://files.readme.io/84ea3cf-airbridge-5.png)

## 

3\. Configure Appier postback settings

  1. Next, go to the **Postback URL** section, and for each event, click the gear icon (under the **Edit** column) to begin configuring that event's postback settings.

![](https://files.readme.io/7a14c20-airbridge-6.png)

  2. Scroll to the bottom of the parameter list, click **\+ Add**. Add the following key-value pair, then click **Save** :
     1. Key: `user_alias`
     2. Value: `{user.alias}`

![](https://files.readme.io/787e7cd-airbridge-7.png)

  3. After you've added the key value pairs for each event, click **Start postback sending**.

![](https://files.readme.io/963f6f5-airbridge-8.png)

## 

4\. Verify that events are collected properly

  1. On the Airbridge console, go to **Raw Data > App real-time Log** and verify that app events are displaying as expected.

![](https://files.readme.io/746cb9a-airbridge-9.png)

  2. On the AIQUA dashboard, click your email in the bottom left corner, then go to **Recent activity** , select the platform your app is on, and verify that app events are displaying as expected.

![](https://files.readme.io/5988f32-airbridge-10.png)

# Analytics Dashboard

## 

Overview

AIQUA's analytics dashboard provides a consolidated, visual summary of campaign performance and user engagement across all channels. The dashboard highlights key metrics, including:

  * Total active and reachable users
  * Total conversion value
  * Campaign activity and performance by campaign type



From the analytics dashboard, you can:

  * Customize the dashboard's date range and enable comparison mode to identify trends, measure impact, and refine your marketing strategy.
  * Directly launch the segment and campaign creation pages.

![](https://files.readme.io/3cf150944ae6691fd6dd5fbd247a2c886c2215ae95a50ceecb8d11ae5bc7af33-analytics-dashboard-overview.gif)

> 👍
> 
> ### 
> 
> Explore widget
> 
> Use the **Explore** widget to:
> 
>   * Quickly launch features such as campaign creation using Campaign Copilot (regular campaigns), campaign experiments (all campaigns types except trigger campaigns), and segment creation.
>   * Open the [monthly product release](doc:aiqua-release-notes) notes to learn more about the latest product updates.
> 
![](https://files.readme.io/112f71814df8b2f265c04424ed24bd9ed9c1e660c3cd152a9a5801591a43e282-explore-widget.png)

### 

Notes and limitations

  * The analytics dashboard is automatically refreshed each day.
  * Data until the previous day is visible on the analytics dashboard. Note that data from the current day is not displayed.
  * You can view data that's up to 750 days old. Historical data beyond 750 days isn't available.
  * Numerical values are rounded to the nearest whole number and percentages will display up to two decimal points.
  * The metrics displayed for SMS campaigns don't include MMS campaign data.
  * Changing your account's [timezone](doc:user-settings#timezone) may cause unexpected effects on performance metrics calculations. If you'd like to change your account's timezone, please contact Appier Support ([[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#462335351935333636293432062736362f23346825292b)) for assistance.



* * *

## 

Open the dashboard

To view the analytics dashboard, go to **Analytics > Dashboard**.

![](https://files.readme.io/83bebb511f48604b0f1eae001103ce7fd5651c6ee4294676f1335739cae5808f-analytics-dashboard-navigation.png)

Each widget allows you to view data for a specific channel or metric, selectable via tabs or dropdown options.

![](https://files.readme.io/aed7a25e7288c1edaaf44803fcdda6f14d84281a01e45c9aa8d8ee0e876f76c9-widget-options.png)

To view details for a specific data point in the chart, hover over the data point.

![](https://files.readme.io/ea4933dac57ee8367ab48d4f94e4f9980dc968cee4225b203ee6700e9bd283fd-widget-hover.png)   


* * *

## 

Set date range and comparison settings

Customize the dashboard's data view by modifying date range and aggregation settings and enabling comparisons with previous time periods.

### 

Date range and aggregation

![](https://files.readme.io/1dc8f0fb52fd3c2655d8b0a11784f0c4702bc1388da9c8c310739338c1bbd8ff-analytics-dashboard-date-range.gif)

The analytics dashboard provides several settings for adjusting the data displayed in the chart widgets.

Setting| Description  
---|---  
Aggregation| Select whether you to aggregate data in the chart by day (**D**), week (**W**), or month (**M**).For example, if you select week (**W**), each data point in the chart contains the total for that week.![](https://files.readme.io/f768d2880ac4fa3370967e41863300a91976b238d2b2ee535f62045cc5361f9a-date-aggregation.png)  
Date range| Select the start and and end date for chart data, then click **Apply**. You can select a start date up to 750 days in the past.![](https://files.readme.io/879cb3744fd876e7fe8e0eb82aa51806fac351f707d1972a33923dd167a312d3-date-picker.png)  
  
### 

Comparing with previous time periods

To enable comparisons with previous time periods, enable **Compare mode** , then click the settings icon to edit the comparison period.

![](https://files.readme.io/cc5dd0be8e4135a9a12bba535697a24ca47a76827c87fe7af46e99da5eef1b35-date-compare-mode.png)

You can select the following comparison types:

Comparison type| Description| Comparison period for: Monday, February 3 – Friday, February 7, 2025  
---|---|---  
**Preceding period**|  Compare with the date range preceding the current date range.| Wednesday, January 29 – Sunday, February 2, 2025The comparison period is the five-day period immediately preceding February 3, 2025.  
**Same period last year**|  Compare with the same date range from the previous year.| Saturday, February 3 – Wednesday, February 7, 2024The comparison period is the same date range in 2024.  
**Preceding period (match day of week)**|  Compare with the preceding date range starting on the same weekday.| Monday, January 27 – Friday, January 31, 2025The comparison period is the five-day period from the starting on previous Monday.  
**Same period last year (match day of week)**|  Compare with the same date range last year, starting on the same weekday.| Monday, February 5 – Friday, February 9, 2024The comparison period is the five-day period starting from the Monday closest to February 3, 2024, which is February 5, 2024.  
**Custom**|  Compare with a custom date range period selected using the date picker.| —  
  
* * *

## 

Create segments and campaigns

Segments can be created from the **Reachable users** widget by clicking the **+** in the top right corner.

![](https://files.readme.io/6551f10816e2f40bc66c3d9fee948b5cbfa953e7a52b23945e6f57171c4894d1-reachable-users-create-segment.png)

To create campaigns, click the **+** button in the top right corner of the widget corresponding to the desired campaign type.

![](https://files.readme.io/7ebb61295fe84d4531305a54216747b7fd3ab5549f1d65f8cdf6adf4aa98b906-widget-campaign-creation.png)

In the **Explore** section, you can also launch campaign creation pages for campaigns using Campaign Copilot (regular push campaigns) and campaign experiments (all campaign types except trigger campaigns).

![](https://files.readme.io/252b1dcd7255d3e780c5c9079fd94ef1e159b7e810e865fb30203663ffee7414-explore-widget.png)

* * *

## 

Chart notes

### 

Reachable users

The change in reachable users is calculated on a daily basis, based on your account's configured time zone. Depending on the channel, the chart displays users who subscribe and unsubscribe within the same calculation period (24 hours) differently:

  * **App push** and **Web push** : Each subscription and unsubscription event is shown in the chart. For example, if a user subscribes to push notifications and unsubscribes in the same day, the chart will show one subscriber and one unsubscriber for that day.
  * **Email** and **LINE** : Users who subscriber/follow, then unsubscribe/unfollow in the same day aren't shown in the chart.

# Analytics Studio

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Beta
> 
> Analytics Studio is a beta feature. Please contact your customer success manager for more details.

## 

Overview

Analytics Studio is a powerful and intuitive tool that allows you to visualize your AIQUA data. Use Analytics Studio to easily create reports using the drag-and-drop interface to add, customize, and reposition chart widgets, allowing you to quickly turn data into actionable, data-driven insights.

![](https://files.readme.io/fb5e4b1-analytics-studio-demo.gif)

* * *

## 

Getting started with Analytics Studio reports

Refer to the following guides to learn how to start using Analytics Studio reports:

  * [**Viewing a Report**](doc:analytics-studio-viewing-a-report): Learn how to view an existing Analytics Studio report
  * [**Creating a Report**](doc:analytics-studio-creating-a-report): Learn how to create a new Analytics Studio report
  * [**Managing Reports**](doc:analytics-studio-managing-reports): Learn about the operations available for Analytics Studio reports, such as pinning, renaming, and editing



* * *

## 

Analytics Studio reference guides

> 👍
> 
> Use the following reference guides when building your reports to learn more about the different components available in Analytics Studio reports.

Refer to the following guides for detailed descriptions about different reports components:

  * [**Chart Types**](doc:analytics-studio-chart-types): Learn about the chart types available for report widgets
  * [**Widget Templates**](doc:analytics-studio-widget-templates): Learn about the prebuilt widget templates Analytics Studio provides
  * [**Data Sources**](doc:analytics-studio-data-sources): See the complete list of dimensions and metrics included in each data source
